title: ee.closeout_audit.v1
description: JSON envelope emitted by scripts/closeout_audit.sh (J11.4 / bd-17c65.10.11.4). Run BEFORE marking a bead closed to summarize verification evidence, retained artifacts, dependencies, and known caveats. Reports closure readiness as `ready`, `ready_with_caveats`, or `blocked`, with structured reasons an agent can act on or paste verbatim into a `br close --reason` invocation. Non-destructive contract: the audit never mutates beads, git, files, agent-mail reservations, or the cargo target. Pinned by bd-2vu8m (SRR6.23 final hardening) because the SRR6 closeout matrix routes through this envelope.

readiness.description: `ready`: zero blockers + zero caveats. `ready_with_caveats`: zero blockers + >=1 caveat. `blocked`: >=1 blocker (the operator must resolve before closing).

blockers.description: Hard blockers that prevent closure. The operator must resolve every entry before `br close` is safe.

caveats.description: Non-blocking caveats the operator should record in the `br close --reason` text so the closure rationale is auditable.

next_actions.description: Concrete commands or steps the operator can run to clear the blockers/caveats.

bead_status.description: Live `br show` status for the bead at audit time (e.g. `open`, `in_progress`, `closed`).

open_dependencies.description: Dependencies that are still not closed. Non-empty entries normally produce a blocker.

dependency_cycles.description: Cycles surfaced by `br dep cycles`. Each entry carries the path and rendered cycle string; `dependency_cycle_count` mirrors `length`.

dependency_cycle_source.description: How the cycles were discovered (`live_br`, `fixture`, `cached`, etc.). Pinned so support bundles can audit replay.

uncommitted_files_referencing_bead.description: Paths in the working tree that mention the bead id but are not yet committed. Each entry usually becomes a caveat or blocker depending on file class.

j1_log_present.description: Whether the bead has a J1 evidence log on disk; missing logs convert to caveats for beads where a J1 log was expected.

enabled.description: True when the audited bead is the SRR6 final hardening parent (bd-2vu8m) or a direct child; false otherwise. When false the rest of the block reports `not_applicable` / empty arrays / matrix_present=false.

matrix_path.description: Resolved path to the SRR6 closeout matrix (typically `scripts/shard_fanout_closeout_matrix.sh` or the docs-shipped matrix file).

matrix_row_present.description: Whether the matrix has a row pinning this bead's required proofs.

missing_proof_markers.description: Stable text markers an operator can grep for to locate the missing-proof origin in the matrix file.

unresolved_dependencies.description: SRR6 dependency bead ids still open. Any entry blocks SRR6 closeout until either closed or explicitly deferred with rationale.

deferred_dependencies_missing_rationale.description: Deferred dependencies that lack a rationale comment in the matrix. Each entry is a blocker — explicit deferral with rationale is required by bd-2vu8m acceptance.
